channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: O'Connor succeeds Chin as Wexford hurling captain
item.description: Jack O'Connor has been named as the new Wexford senior hurling captain.

item.title: Camogie Club Championship Team of the Year named
item.description: The Camogie Association have announced the AIB Camogie Club Championship Team of the Year.

item.title: Daly expects "fascinating" Galway-Kilkenny showdown in Salthill
item.description: Former Clare manager Anthony Daly says he expects a "fascinating" showdown between Kilkenny and Galway on Saturday (5.15pm).

item.title: "It's hard to say no to the opportunity"
item.description: Two-time All-Ireland winner Mary-Kate Lynch says it was "hard to say no" to the opportunity of pursing a professional career in the Women's AFL.

item.title: Tyrone have "a lot to work on", says Donnelly
item.description: Tyrone forward Mattie Donnelly says the Red Hands' next two Allianz League outings are "massive" as they gear up for next month's Ulster SFC preliminary round showdown with rivals Armagh.

item.title: "The environment wasn't right for me to stay" - McBride
item.description: Former Antrim forward Patrick McBride says the environment wasn't right for him to remain in the Glensmen's senior football squad this season.

item.title: Grugan aiming to be back for Armagh's championship campaign
item.description: Armagh forward Rory Grugan says he hopes to be back available for selection for the Orchard men's championship campaign which commences against Tyrone next month.

item.title: Cork not looking beyond Limerick clash - O'Connor
item.description: Cork boss Ben O'Connor says his team are not looking beyond this Saturday evening's showdown against Limerick at the TUS Gaelic Grounds (7pm).

item.title: Daingean Uí Chúis dominate Club Football Team of the Year
item.description: The GAA have announced the AIB GAA Football Club Championship Team of the Year.

item.title: Antrim on the up again on Dowds' second coming
item.description: Elaine Dowds would love to start International Women's Day on Sunday morning with a warm glow of victory still coursing through her veins.
